## First 72-Hour Launch Giveaway

## Join Our Community
This campaign is fully managed and promoted by Vinyl, an official Kickstarter Expert Partner.
Since 2017, Vinyl has raised over $200M on Kickstarter and led multiple million-dollar projects, including LaserPecker ($10M+), Makera Z1 ($10M+), Nestworks ($10M+) and AnkerMake ($8M+), providing expert promotion and marketing services to drive global success.
risks: Every crowdfunding journey comes with a few uncertainties, but ToolDance is backed by an experienced team with a strong background in CNC, precision manufacturing, hardware development, and software. Our team has spent years building CNC and precision manufacturing solutions, developing the experience needed to turn complex engineering into reliable products. From product design and manufacturing to quality control, delivery, and after-sales support, we’ve spent significant time refining every part of ToolDance X1 to create a machine that is reliable, capable, and easy to use. That experience gives us the confidence to manage production timelines, maintain high quality standards, and tackle challenges along the way. We’ll keep our backers informed with regular updates as we move through the final stages of development and manufacturing. If anything unexpected comes up, we’ll address it openly and do everything we can to keep the project moving forward and deliver the ToolDance X1 experience we’ve promised.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | I paid the $30 VIP deposit. Do I still need to pledge on Kickstarter?
faq.a: Yes. Your $30 deposit reserves your VIP benefits, but it does not place a Kickstarter pledge or pay for your machine. To receive your reward, you’ll need to select your preferred ToolDance X1 bundle and complete your pledge on Kickstarter.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | How does VIP pricing work?
faq.a:
The VIP prices shown in the images are AFTER cashback. You’ll pledge at the Super Early Bird price on Kickstarter.

• Single-machine bundles: $200 VIP cashback
• X1 Twin Pack: $400 VIP cashback

After the campaign ends successfully and we verify your VIP status and pledge, we’ll issue your cashback as a partial refund through Kickstarter.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | How do I claim my VIP cashback?
faq.a: Choose your preferred Super Early Bird bundle and confirm your pledge on Kickstarter. After the campaign ends successfully, we’ll verify your VIP status and pledge and process the applicable cashback. Please use the same email address as your VIP deposit where possible. If the addresses differ, contact us so we can match your records.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | What if my Kickstarter email is different from my VIP deposit email?
faq.a:
If your Kickstarter email differs from your deposit email, please contact info@tooldance.ai after backing ToolDance X1. Send the message from your deposit email and include your Kickstarter email so our team can update your information.

There is no immediate rush to update your email. Just ensure you contact us before we begin processing VIP cashback after the campaign ends.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | What happens to my $30 VIP deposit?
faq.a:
Your $30 deposit will be refunded separately after the campaign ends, in addition to your VIP cashback.

Changed your mind? Your deposit is fully refundable.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Can I get two machines? Do add-ons qualify for VIP cashback?
faq.a:
Yes! Choose the X1 Twin Pack for two machines and $400 in VIP cashback.

Each Kickstarter account can select one reward tier per project. Add-ons are available at Super Early Bird prices but do not qualify for additional VIP cashback.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Can I get VIP discounts on different machine bundles using different VIP email addresses?
faq.a:
Yes. Each Kickstarter account can select one reward tier per project. If you paid VIP deposits using different email addresses, you can use a separate Kickstarter account for each deposit to back different machine bundles. 

Each account linked to a VIP deposit will receive the VIP cashback for its selected bundle after the campaign ends.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Do I need to pledge during the first hour to keep my VIP benefits?
faq.a: No. You do not need to pledge within the first hour to qualify for your VIP cashback. We’re reserving sufficient Super Early Bird rewards for VIP members across time zones. You still need to complete an eligible Kickstarter pledge during the campaign.

faq.q: VIP & Pricing | Where can I compare bundle prices and included accessories?
faq.a: Please check the bundle comparison chart and reward descriptions on the campaign page. They show each bundle’s Super Early Bird price, included modules, and price after VIP cashback. Choose based on the materials, part geometry, and cooling or dust collection setup you need.

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | When will I be charged?
faq.a:
If you back ToolDance X1 during the live campaign, you’ll only be charged when the campaign ends successfully. If the funding goal is not reached, you won’t be charged.

If you choose Pledge Over Time at checkout, your pledge will be split into three equal payments: the first when the campaign ends successfully, followed by two monthly payments. You can review the payment dates at checkout.

For more details on when you’ll be charged:
https://help.kickstarter.com/en-us/articles/16236544-when-is-…

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | What payment methods can I use?
faq.a:
Kickstarter accepts major debit and credit cards, including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Discover, UnionPay, and JCB are accepted for US-based projects only. PayPal is not supported. Please check the payment options shown at checkout.

For the full list of supported payment methods and restrictions, visit:
https://help.kickstarter.com/en-us/articles/16236687-what-forms-of-payment-can-i-use-to-make-a-pledge

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | Can I pay in installments?
faq.a:
Yes! We have enabled Kickstarter’s Pledge Over Time option, allowing eligible backers to split their pledge into three equal payments.

The first payment is collected when the campaign ends successfully, followed by two monthly payments. You’ll see your payment schedule at checkout.

For more details, please refer to Kickstarter’s Pledge Over Time guide 
https://help.kickstarter.com/en-us/articles/16236390-pledge-over-time-common-questions

faq.q: Reward & Add-on | How do I change my bundle or add accessories?
faq.a:
While the campaign is live, you can update your pledge to choose an available bundle or add accessories.

1️⃣ Sign in to Kickstarter and open the ToolDance X1 campaign page.
2️⃣ Click Manage your pledge → Change your pledge.
3️⃣ Keep your current reward or choose another available bundle.
4️⃣ Select or adjust your add-ons.
5️⃣ Review the updated total and complete the confirmation steps to save your changes.

For detailed instructions, visit:
https://help.kickstarter.com/en-us/articles/16236517-…

faq.q: Reward & Add-on | I forgot to add an accessory. What should I do?
faq.a:
You can add available accessories while the campaign is live—there’s no need to cancel and pledge again.

1️⃣ Sign in and open the ToolDance X1 campaign page.
2️⃣ Click Manage your pledge → Change your pledge.
3️⃣ Keep your current reward and select the add-ons you want.
4️⃣ Review the updated total and complete the confirmation steps to save your changes.

⚠️Note:
✅ Adding accessories or changing your reward during the campaign does not change your Backer Number.

faq.q: Payment & Pledges | What should I do if my payment fails after the campaign ends?
faq.a:
Sign in to Kickstarter and click Fix payment, or use the link in Kickstarter’s payment failure email. Follow the steps to retry your payment or use a different card. If it still fails, contact your bank or card issuer.

You have 7 days AFTER the campaign ends to fix a failed campaign payment. If you use Pledge Over Time, the deadline is 7 days for the first payment and 14 days for the second or third payment. Follow the deadline in Kickstarter’s notification to avoid losing your pledge.
